title: Short, specific title describing the problem
category: IA | CONTENT | FORM | A11Y | MOBILE | PERF | SEO | TRUST | PWA
why_it_matters: User impact + business impact in 1–2 sentences.
recommendation: Specific, actionable fix. Include the element, the change, and the expected result.
acceptance_criteria: Observable condition 1 that confirms the fix is complete
retest_method: Playwright scenario | axe rerun | manual keyboard check | Lighthouse rerun | usability task
